notes.title: 1.4 patch
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33633857/c61ccc01247e45ff8ded9b31b7f7c51031e6d932.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33633857/8deaf4710b119a612fad85f1cc38d741eea6d6ec.png[/img][/url]

Sorry for the long wait, this patch was kinda big.
- Yasmine, a new character, was added to the game
- Setup screen that lets you set up a time, ending, and punishment options (you can even completely switch it off)
- Many QoL changes (separate moan/laugh sound settings, typo fixes thanks to a certain helpful fan, and such)


This is the last big patch to Fap Queen 1, since I am already planning the second part. That'll have its own announcement, I am just hinting a bit :D

notes.title: Achievements are in!
notes.content:
Well, the title says it all :D
But there are also some other changes, to respond to some of the problems some reviews mention. 
- The game now explicitely warns you after your session time that you should push a certain button unless you want the game to go on forever 
- you can do a denial scenario (since it is No Nut November :D)
- some new lines added
- fullscreen mode is in (actually that was always in, but now it is on a button on the top right corner)
- an additional button that might be useful in some shameful cases :D
